newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia says only 1,494 HK people in country.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia says only 1,494 HK people in country.

text.p: Indonesian immigration authorities said on Friday there were 1,494 Hong Kong people working in the country, far fewer than reported earlier.

On Monday, immigration officials said Jakarta would ask some 60,000 Hong Kong people working in Indonesia to leave by June because their travel documents might not be valid after China takes over the British colony at midnight on June 30.

But Hong Kong authorities assured Indonesia the same day that the territory's travel documents would remain valid after the handover, and Indonesia has since accepted that Hong Kong workers would not need to revalidate their documents.

Director-General of Immigration Pranowo said on Friday there were 1,494 Hong Kong people living in Indonesia, adding that 1,401 of them hold temporary residency permits and the rest had permanent permits.

"They work in textile factories, the silver handicraft industry and other industry and trade sectors. Most of them live in Jakarta, Surabaya and Bandung," Pranowo said in a statement faxed to Reuters.
"It is not true that the number of Hong Kong people in Indonesia is 60,000," Pranowo said.
The statement gave no further details.
